probejs-legacy.filterJavaImports.markdownDescription:
Filter auto-imports from `"java:"` module paths.
Changing this setting will trigger reload of the TS Server.

probejs-legacy.redirectJavaImports.markdownDescription:
Redirect `"java:"` imports to `Java.loadClass()` calls.
Changing this setting will trigger reload of the TS Server.

probejs-legacy.redirectTemplate.markdownDescription:
Template for redirected imports. `{class_name}` = short class name, `{package_name}` = Java package path.
Default: `const ${class_name} = Java.loadClass("{package_name}.{class_name}")`
Changing this setting will trigger reload of the TS Server.

scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "const{cpSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs');const d='node_modules/probejs-tsserver-plugin';mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});cpSync('tss_plugin/out',d+'/out',{recursive:true});cpSync('tss_plugin/package.json',d+'/package.json')" && vsce package --allow-missing-repository
